strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Elshank destroyed
Princess Romina, this is as far as we can go.
So the Elshank can't move at all now...
Stranded out here...
Yes... All the fighting seems to have put a heavy strain on the Elshank.
The micro-wormhole drive must have pushed it too far...
Umon, Maria... I'm so sorry...
At this rate... we can't rendezvous...
Please don't lose heart, Princess Romina.
We've already sent a distress signal, and I hear Londo Bell
is sending someone to get us. Let's wait for them calmly.
But, Umon...
It's okay, Princess Romina. My brother isn't smooth enough to lie to a woman.
Maria... Encouraging Princess Romina is fine,
but you don't have to tease me, do you?
Hahaha, even serious Daisuke is helpless against Maria.
Well, it's true, isn't it? Hehe.
Hahaha... Hm?
Damian, what is it?
Looks like playtime's over. ...Daisuke!
Huh!? What!?
Yes, so it seems... Everyone, be careful. Here they come...!
Oh, what's this? This battleship... Is it the one Boss Gil mentioned,
the one from another planet!? Which means...
What!? Who are these guys...!?
You... You're from the space crime syndicate Gyandlar!
Hm? That voice... What, ol' four-horns is here too?
...Ahh, you came to mess up the colony drop. Ain't that a drag!
It's gotta be a big splash, or it'll be a pain later.
What's that supposed to mean!? If you're after conquering Earth,
wouldn't a colony dropping be bad for you too!?
...It seems what they're after isn't Earth itself,
but something on Earth.
Whoops, my bad.
Too late, too late. I heard every word!
Don't matter! If I finish you all off here, nobody'll know!
Get ready! Kina, I brought ya along, so let 'em have it!
Rom... Where's Rom Stol? This isn't what we agreed...!
I told ya, you'll get to meet him eventually.
Sis, if we keep fighting like this, he's bound to show up. Until then...!
Fine. Devil Saturn, I'll do it.
Good girl. Now then, get ready all over again!
This time I got some heavy hitters from the Bunker! Get 'em!
Umon, at this rate...!
Don't worry, Princess Romina. ...Your planet and Earth alike...
I'll never let a tragedy like Planet Fleed's happen again...!
Brother! Let's go!
Duuuuke Fleeeeeed!
Dizer, Gooo!
Come on, Gyandlar!
I won't let the likes of you ravage the beautiful Earth!
You sure talk a lot! Get ready!
(How long can we hold out? At this rate, their numbers will crush us...!)
Dammit... Too many enemies, and the Elshank can't even move...
Shaff, can't we somehow move to support Duke?
The output won't rise. We can fire the guns, but...
Gameran!
We can only intercept enemies within range!
Brother! We can't go down in a place like this!
Right. Hang on until Londo Bell arrives, Maria.
Not bad, four-horns! But we got numbers. You can't hold out forever!
Ngh... Grendizer won't lose to people who think numbers are strength!
Quit your yappin'! Hm...
Hey, Kina, Colon! Whaddaya doin'? Get in there already!
My target is only Rom... And I don't like winning by numbers.
What!? Think about whether you're in any position to complain!
Infighting...? Whatever, if we can use this chance...
...Joe... Tobikage...!
Ahh, forget it! Guess I'll have to do it myself...
Kenrou!
Devil Saturn, what a nasty piece of work.
Helping drop a colony on that planet.
...We shouldn't get involved in this star system's wars...
But! If you villains want it, I won't stand idly by...!
Are you all right?
You...! Thank you, it seems you've saved us again.
Don't sweat it. You helped us out last time.
Oh? It seems to be a different battleship than usual...
Commander Hazuki told us of mystery helpers who show up in space...
That'd be us, right, Brother?
We'll explain later. We're allies, pursuing Gyandlar.
Thank you... Um, may I ask your name...?
...Rom Stol. I'll help you in this fight...!
...!! I knew it... Rom Stol!
Hm?
You're...!?
No more talk! Die! Rom Stol!
Seems there's some history here... Anyway, let's fight back!
Why are you after me!
You don't look like one of Gyandlar's monster commanders.
Don't mess with us! You killed our father!
Their father's killer? You, Brother!?
Impossible! You must have the wrong person.
It's not the wrong person!
...I am Kina, daughter of the Bison Warrior Jingi!
And I'm Colon!
Jingi's... children. That was a duel between martial artists.
Win or lose, it was fate... Neither side should hold a grudge.
Someone you fought before?
Long ago, on our planet. Rom won the one-on-one duel.
The finishing move was the Cyclone Driver... right, Rom?
Yes. True to his name, he was a warrior who lived by honor.
You can make all the excuses you want!
You killed our father!
Ngh, the enemy got here first... All units, prepare to launch!
Support the Elshank!
All right, hang on, Duke! We're coming!
Even Duke Fleed seems to have been having a hard time...
Now that I'm here, there's nothing to worry about!
Umon, Maria! ...Did we make it in time!?
The Ra Cailum!? Everyone from Londo Bell!
Looks like we managed to hold out...
Thank goodness...
It's the Elshank.
Heard it broke down again. You guys even maintaining it!?
Don't say that, Thunder.
Princess Romina!
Joe!? What? What is going on!?
How did you get to space!?
It's embarrassing. We fell for an enemy trap and got blasted up here.
It worked out, though, since now we can back you up.
I'm worried about things on the ground, though...
Is that... those aliens again?
We got here first, hope you don't mind.
Gyandlar was trying to drag innocent people into things again.
You guys have it rough too, huh?
Folks from other planets worrying about us... Sad for us Earthlings.
First Rom's gang, and now Earthling reinforcements!
I can't take this! I'll be back!
Ngh! Rom... My father's killer... I swear...!
Ah, he ran!
That robot sure runs away a lot, huh?
Some would say he knows when to make a clean exit.
Whatever the case, his type lives long.
Master Rom, don't you think the people of Earth will be all right now?
...Yes. But a colony drop would be very convenient for them.
Can't stand them sneaking around in the shadows. ...After them, Rom?
Convenient!? What do you mean?
I'll explain later. Rom... if you're going after them, sooner is better.
Thank you for your concern.
To protect this beautiful blue planet... may you stop the colony drop.
We'll be supporting you from the shadows.
Looks like we owe them another one...
Way too cool... Most people could never pull it off like that.
All right! We'll keep Gyandlar and the Bunker in check!
...Please wait!
What is it?
Among the Bunker... was there a man called Gil...?
Mia...
No, I've never heard of him... Who is he?
Well, he's a guy who's been hounding us relentlessly...
We don't really know what the Bunker is after. This Earth business...
is mainly Gyandlar's doing.
I see...
Let's go, everyone. ...People of Earth, good luck to you.
They're already out of sight. Amazing...
Well, we've linked up, so let's clean up the rest!
What!? What kinda attack is that! Forget it! I ain't stickin' around!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Ngh! Rom... My father's killer... I swear...!
Wait! Dammit... I can't go after him alone here...
We'll pursue him. He seems to be plotting something bad...
Master Rom, don't you think the people of Earth will be all right now?
...Yes. But a colony drop would be very convenient for them.
Can't stand them sneaking around in the shadows. ...After them, Rom?
All right, let's go. ...People of Earth, good luck to you.
All right, we'll catch up in no time!
Phew, they saved us, but what's with them?
They're always like that... But they're as dashing as ever.
They truly are...
We can't rely on them entirely.
Until Londo Bell arrives, we'll have to hold on by ourselves.
Ngh! Rom... My father's killer... I swear...!
It's over... Thank you very much, everyone.
Glad we made it in time. Looks like it was a real brawl.
Rom and the others... those mystery heroes came and saved us.
Yes, we managed to link up safely.
We've yet to introduce ourselves, but time is short, isn't it?
Yes... Given the time left to stop the colony drop, it's cutting close.
Then we'd better hurry!
Well, isn't it good we've got another battleship?
Ah... I'm afraid the Elshank can't come along.
Whaaat!?
It's not completely immobile,
but it's in no shape for combat.
Nothing goes right, huh?
Just linking up with Grendizer and the others is...
Yes, just linking up with Duke and Maria is reassuring.
We should be content with linking up with Grendizer and the others.
Yes, just having Duke and Maria with us is reassuring.
But where should the Elshank go now...?
Rest assured, Princess Romina.
We've arranged for the Elshank to head to Anaheim
and undergo repairs there.
Anaheim?
We'd already received a report of the Elshank's trouble.
Captain Bright listed it as a Londo Bell supply ship
and got it clearance to dock.
Pretty slick, for a dopey captain.
Pai! That's rude.
The Captain's always got a lot on his mind, after all.
So, we send the Elshank to Anaheim...
and we hurry to catch up with the colony!
Glad to see you're safe too, Akira.
Geez, I was worried about you...!
Sorry... But we've finally all regrouped... Let's hurry on!
Okaaay, question!
Wasn't Raideen supposed to be with the Elshank, too?
Yes... Raideen's pilot, Akira Hibiki,
apparently had something he really needed to look into.
After checking on it, he'll join the Ra Cailum by another route.
He always did seem to have good instincts... Fine, let's hurry!
Come to think of it, what will become of that person... Ple?
Ple!? Did you say Ple!?
Ple... You mean Elpeo Ple!?
Yeah, I'm pretty sure that was her name.
She was missing... and you found her! Where is she now? Is she okay!?
It's all right, Judau.
She hasn't regained consciousness yet... but her life isn't in danger.
I do think she should be moved somewhere with proper facilities...
It's on the way anyway... Anaheim or Von Braun would be best.
Indeed. Judau... was it?
We'll take responsibility for bringing your friend there. Please don't worry.
Oh, thanks, that's real kind of you... All right, I'm feeling fired up!
Let's go, everyone!
